item.text:
| Feature | Offer A | Offer B |
|---|---|---|
| Price, excluding sales tax | CAD 1,100/year | CAD 120/month |
| Cost over 12 months, excluding sales tax | CAD 1,100 | CAD 1,440 |
| Devices covered | 6 | 10 |
| Support | Email | Phone |

Offer A costs CAD 340 less over 12 months. Offer B covers 4 more devices and provides phone rather than email support.

Neither is clearly better without knowing the buyer’s device count and support needs.
